summary: StudentPreInfControl is a user control within the HSPnet application that manages student infection control prerequisites, including N95 mask fit test details and infection control solutions. It enables viewing, editing, and updating of relevant fields for a student and handles localization, field validations, dropdown selections, and asynchronous operations.
purpose: The purpose of StudentPreInfControl is to facilitate the capture, display, and management of student prerequisites related to infection control, such as N95 mask fit test dates/sizes and infection control solution selections. It provides workflows for data entry, validation, and ensures proper localization and system behavior during updates.

workflows.name: Prerequisite Detail Update
steps: Data binding occurs, setting up fields and localizing display.
Dropdowns are populated and translated as needed.
FormView (uxDetail) shows current student prerequisite data.
User initiates edit or insert mode.
User saves or updates prerequisite details.
New values are read from dropdowns and input fields.
System caches session and redirects user after update.

workflows.name: Dropdown Initialization and Selection
steps: Populate dropdowns for N95 mask size, alt size, fit test date, infection control solution.
Set 'Unknown' value in dropdown, handling localization.
Select and display current values from StudentPrerequisite data.
Add blank entry to dropdown when needed.

business_rules: If UserSession is null, selection is cancelled.
All changes require Page.IsValid to be true.
Dropdown values must be set according to business logic and localization.
Unknown values must be handled explicitly for English display irrespective of system language.
ScreenIsEditable and ReadOnly control field visibility and editability.
validations: Dropdown value selection and verify correct value retrieval.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable flag determines if fields are editable.
ReadOnly flag disables edit fields and calendar controls.
Dropdown blank entry is added when required.
system_behavior: Handles async postback and startup script registration.
Caches user session and redirects after update.
Translates display fields at runtime based on user session language.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, selection is cancelled.
If Page.IsValid is false, update is cancelled.
